observation.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s "https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:minio/minio:pull" | sed -n 's/.*"token":"\([^"]*\).*/\1/p'); echo "token len: ${#TOKEN}"; for tag in latest RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z; do CODE=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/minio/minio/manifests/$tag" -H "Accept: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json"); echo "minio/minio:$tag -> $CODE"; done
